high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation slide titled "Optimizing for logical consistency." The slide is numbered 17 and features a bar chart comparing the "Fact verification accuracy" of two models: "Base model" and "Consistency optimization." The base model has a fact verification accuracy of approximately 70%, while the consistency optimization model achieves an accuracy of around 90%. The chart uses teal and green bars to represent these values. On the right side of the image, there is a person standing on a stage, gesturing with their hands as if explaining something.
